one_line: Demonstrates how chin position alters nose perception using visual data and interactive exercises.

hook.what_happens: A split-screen comparison of a woman's face with the text 'Think your nose is too big?'
hook.why_it_works: It targets a common facial insecurity with a surprising visual contrast.

Same face, same nose.

Hold it there.

narrative_arc: Challenge the viewer's perception of their nose size.
Reveal that chin position dictates perceived nose size.
Provide data-driven proof via pixel analysis.
Engage the viewer with an interactive physical test.
Introduce the AI tool as a way to preview these changes on oneself.
what_makes_it_work: Uses a counter-intuitive optical illusion to capture attention.
Provides empirical proof with pixel-change data.
Includes an interactive physical test that immediately proves the concept to the viewer.

animations.name: Before/After Slider Sweep
animations.what_moves: Vertical divider line and the mask revealing the 'after' image
animations.purpose: Demonstrates subtle facial changes by directly comparing before and after states side-by-side.
animations.reusable_as: Comparing any two states of an image, like color grading or photo editing results.

animations.name: Chin and Jaw Highlight
animations.what_moves: An oval outline highlighting the chin area
animations.purpose: Directs viewer attention to the specific facial region modified by the procedure.
animations.reusable_as: Highlighting key details in product demos or technical diagrams.

animations.name: Pixel Change Bar Chart
animations.what_moves: Vertical bars representing pixel change percentages
animations.purpose: Quantifies and visualizes where the most significant changes occurred on the face.
animations.reusable_as: Displaying statistical data or comparison metrics in any infographic.
animations.would_need_building: An animated bar chart component where vertical bars scale up from zero and numerical labels count up to their final values.

animations.name: Interactive Step List
animations.purpose: Guides the user through a physical self-test to experience the visual illusion.
animations.reusable_as: Displaying multi-step tutorials, recipes, or onboarding flows.

animations.name: Search Bar Typing
animations.what_moves: Text characters appearing inside a search input field
animations.purpose: Creates a clear call-to-action by simulating a user typing the brand name into a search engine.
animations.reusable_as: Ending cards prompting users to search for a specific keyword or website.
animations.would_need_building: A simulated text input component that types out a string character-by-character with an optional blinking cursor.
